svg.title: Connect, 24 px fit A
svg.desc: Oath & Action Civic Line CL-021 Connect, pixel-fit master for 24 px, fit A: a 2 px line on the pixel grid, every feature and red placement of the master kept, the red its own shapes in the accent group (DR-133, stage B). Use at 24 px only; the black edition is the one in use under 48 px.
